recap.text: Signet meets Carl and a cat outside Grimaldi's Traveling Circus. She casts Water Lily to put the cat to sleep after Carl calls her an asshole. Signet spends Heather's blood to make her retinue as tall as houses and break the defenders. Carl reads a spellbook for Wisp Armor and agrees to join Signet in the Vengeance of the Daughter.

Signet is the exiled daughter of King Finian and a Naiad princess. She summons Blood and Ink tattoos by casting on a sacrifice another hand must kill. She joins Carl to fight the Confederacy and High Elves, then takes her mother's palace. After learning her life is a programme, Signet cuts her own throat with Carl's knife and vanishes into the Nothing.

beats.headline: Met outside Grimaldi's circus
beats.text: Night comes down on the Over City and the mobs form their lines around Grimaldi's Traveling Circus. Two crawlers have come to scout it, a man and a cat, and they leave under magical mortar fire, and I am what they run into on the other side. My charisma stands past a hundred. He stares, as they all stare. Then he snaps his own finger, and it breaks. I have not decided whether to be offended.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet meets a man and a cat outside Grimaldi's Traveling Circus in the Over City.

beats.headline: The sacrifice who took no scratch
beats.text: My lovelies take blood, and only the blood of a proper sacrifice. I may not bleed it myself; I must set two creatures against each other, guess the loser, and cast upon it before its first wound. Tonight I chose Carl. Primal blood; I could sense its power. But he took nary a scratch, six lions lie dead, and the night's attack is canceled. My boys were so looking forward to it. So I invite them to hear the sad tale of Signet the Bastard and Grimaldi, the man she loved. Tomorrow, an hour after sundown, right here.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet invites Carl to hear a tale about herself and Grimaldi.

beats.headline: Water Lily
beats.text: I followed them this morning to see whether Carl would keep his promise. He did not, and he called me an asshole. I could have melted them both. Instead, grace, which my mother taught me, and heirloom magic, which she also taught me. Water Lily. The cat sleeps until I cancel it. If I die, she dies. If she is moved, she dies. Carl may earn her back by keeping his word. Tonight he will kill Heather, and her blood will raise my squad.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet uses heirloom magic to put a cat to sleep until Carl keeps his word.

beats.headline: The paper army
beats.text: Heather's blood is powerful indeed, and I spend it all: my entire retinue, their longevity traded for strength. My lovelies leave my skin as tall as houses, and we break the defenders at the strongest we have been in a long while. I stop the calliope myself. The serpent's waterspout dies against the big top, as it always does; the ancient magic holds, and I am banished from within. So Carl will go in with a clown's ticket and break the three poles. He freed Heather tonight. She was family. This is what you do for family.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet trades her retinue's longevity for strength to break the defenders and stop the calliope.

beats.headline: Carl signs on to her show
beats.text: Grimaldi has lifted my banishment. Carl went into his head to ask him, and I asked with him. I may leave the circus behind me at last and go where my vengeance waits, and that is the sixth floor, not here. Carl has agreed to be part of it as well, the Vengeance of the Daughter, when it comes to its proper act. Before he went in he sat and read a spellbook. Wisp Armor. It guards the mind against control, and he wanted it on him before he swallowed the worms that let Grimaldi speak inside his skull. He does not walk into another creature's mind unarmoured. Nor would I.
beats.gist: Carl signs on to Tsarina Signet's show, the Vengeance of the Daughter, to seek vengeance.

beats.headline: Daughter of King Finian, and of nobody
beats.text: I am the daughter of King Finian of the High Elves of the Liana Sector, and of a Naiad princess. She was murdered, and the Confederacy took her crown. Both halves of my family then agreed on one thing, which was that I should not exist among them. I was a child. Grimaldi's circus took me in when no throne would. That is the whole of my inheritance: a name, an exile, and a tent.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet is the daughter of King Finian and a murdered Naiad princess.

beats.headline: Blood magic, cast on a loser
beats.text: The tattoos move under my skin because they are not pictures. They are Blood and Ink Elementals, and I raise them. The craft is exact. I set two creatures against each other and I cast on the one I judge will lose, before it has taken a single wound. I may not bleed the sacrifice myself; that is the law of it. Only the killing blow, struck by another hand, releases what I need. One summoning a night. Judge badly and the night is wasted.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet raises Blood and Ink Elementals from moving tattoos to cast blood magic on losers.

beats.headline: Her loyalty does not extend to crawlers
beats.text: I will say it plainly, since the crawlers already know. I tried to make Carl my blood sacrifice, and not with his consent. I put Donut under the Water Lily Spell. I made him bring me to the cursed circus when he had other places to be. I do not regret one piece of it. Everything I have is owed to the family that took me in when no other would, and a crawler is not family.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet tried to make Carl a non-consensual blood sacrifice and put Donut under the Water Lily Spell.

beats.headline: She brings him a hunter
beats.text: Who said anything about hiding, old friend? We came seeking Carl, and found others are seeking him as well. My friends range north to keep the path clear; one invader slipped past. Some idiots have destroyed bridges, so this town is the only way into the Liana district. With me is Areson the Wise, and Clint and his brothers, were-kin, who share my enemy. The hunter lies bound across my caterpillar's saddles. I thought to use him for my blood sacrifice, but it is Carl's kill. Heal him, he says. Still soft. Not anymore, he says, and puts on a ring.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet brings a bound hunter on caterpillar saddles to Carl and Areson the Wise.

beats.headline: Two cancers in a sacred land
beats.text: The crawler has looted the dead hunter. My mother is long dead. My father is gone, and his daughter, my half-sister, rules the high elves. I am recruiting a team, and he and the cat are the last pieces. Grimaldi killed the parasites and set our family free, all but himself, whom I took with me; his story in this is mostly done. There are two great cancers in this once-beautiful land, and with every breath left in me I will cut both of them free. The Confederacy and the High Elves.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet recruits the crawler and the cat to cut the Confederacy and High Elves from the land.

beats.headline: Part of my family
beats.text: Fort Freedom glitters in the dark, and it is falling apart. If they had only waited, the confederates would have had it without blood. I was my mother's only child and never eligible under the imperial charter; rule would have gone back to the people. They killed her just before she was to become tsarina. I think she meant to step down. My tears do not touch my skin. I tell Carl that if something happens to me tonight, I appreciate all he has done, and I consider him part of my family now. And family is very important to me.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet tells Carl he is part of her family while Fort Freedom falls apart.

beats.headline: Water does not touch me
beats.text: Water shies from me as I walk into my mother's palace, the way iron filings flee a magnet. It is the curse. A high elf cast it the night my mother died; the dissenters who killed the tsar and his family managed it only with high elf help. I float like an apple, so my hammerhead, the one with the body of a man, takes me in his arms and carries me down. Once I am deep enough I do not rise again. I have a spell for air.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet walks into her mother's palace and water shies from her like iron filings.

beats.headline: It was barely a fight
beats.text: We have taken the castle. If I had known it was defended so poorly, I would have gone in myself. There were guards enough, but it would have fallen in months on its own: an algae infestation, and confederates who stopped trying to rule ages ago and lost the throne room to an eryops. The kingdom is in shambles. Once we are free of the high elves, I must find a suitable ruler to begin the long work. My mother weeps from beyond the veil. The cat asks if I will rule. Not with my curse. I will never be able to remove it.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet says the castle fell because of an algae infestation and an eryops in the throne room.

beats.headline: Di-we, and the ones born of him
beats.text: Edgar works the new tattoo into my thigh from what remains of Miss Nadine. My tattoos are fallen companions, or fallen enemies we have deemed worthy. I received the first on the night of my mother's murder, the same night I met Edgar. The second is Di-we, a three-headed nodling who died protecting me from agents of my sister. When a nodling dies, he splits: Areson, Apollon and Herman were born the day he fell. The new one on my skin is not Miss Nadine. She is a facsimile. A loving memory.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet has tattoos of fallen companions and worthy enemies on her skin.

beats.headline: The forest cries
beats.text: I wait for them at the edge of the town, with Holger and Areson, to warn them, and then we go, because the elves hunt us. Carl says the cat has tamed Tina's mother, not Tina. Be careful. The hierarchy is fragile; kill the alpha and the whole pack turns at once. Never rely on a single point of failure. And the trees cry out against the brambles. They and the dryads cast to summon Diwata, who does not forgive apostates. Stay away from the all-trees. They whisper.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet waits at the town edge with Holger and Areson to warn them.

beats.headline: On a log, so very tired
beats.text: Everything is dying, and there is still beauty. I have never seen a Gehenna bramble this aggressive. Carl sits beside me and I put my head on his shoulder, and I tell him I am so very tired. Grimaldi we planted by an all-tree node, and the roots intertwined. My soldiers are hidden. When night falls and his party begins, we strike Imogen. Carl says it is a trap, that they will not let us win. Who is they? I need someone inside the castle. Then he says he has a better idea. Tell me your idea.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet tells Carl she is tired while they sit beside aggressive Gehenna brambles.

beats.headline: Apito's own invitation
beats.text: I was sitting in a damp, dark dungeon beneath my sister's castle, minding my own thoughts, when Apito herself appeared before me and told me I was invited to a party. And suddenly I was here, in the ballroom, among Carl's crawlers. The guard at the door stared at me with his mouth open, then turned and fled the room, shouting. I walked up to Carl and took his hands in mine. Would he like to hear something funny? I told him.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet moves from a damp, dark dungeon to a ballroom to speak with Carl.

beats.headline: No boon has ever been granted
beats.text: My sister is not here yet. I would not have believed this was a true Butcher's Masquerade had Apito not come to me herself, and I prefer it this way. I am tired of running. Her guards gather at the entrance, look at me and slink back to the hallway; they cannot touch me without breaking the seal. Carl asks what boon she hopes for. Some sort of immortality, the story goes. It has never once been granted. Then I notice three judges whose auras are strange.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet tells Carl she is tired of running and hopes for immortality.

beats.headline: She hears what Carl was trying to tell her
beats.text: Carl tried to tell me and I would not hear it. I hear it now. My mother's murder, my exile, the circus, the vengeance I have carried since I was a child: it is a programme. It is watched across the galaxy. There are people outside this floor who decide when I grieve and when I strike, and who count how many are watching while I do it. I understand him now.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet understands Carl and realizes her grief and vengeance are a televised galactic programme.

beats.headline: Caster, sacrifice and killer
beats.text: I eat an acorn from the goddess's tree, and my tattoos begin to swirl. The creature D'Nadia told me my mother was never real, and that my fallen brothers and sisters, whose memories adorn my body, never were. She also told me she had looked forward to meeting Carl on the battlefield outside Larracos. Ink Marauder needs three: a caster, a sacrifice, and one to kill the sacrifice. It can be one who is all three. Ask Donut for her Torch, with moon rays. Just tell me when.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet eats an acorn from the goddess's tree and her tattoos swirl.

beats.headline: She opens her own throat
beats.text: Tsarina Signet sits down beside her sister, rigid and glowing, holding a knife she borrowed from Carl. She has two regrets: that she never said goodbye to her Grimaldi, and that she will not be the one to kill Imogen today. She and her mother were going to leave for an island. Then she draws the knife across her own throat. Every acorn falls from the tree at once. The floor opens, the Nothing takes her while Imogen grabs at her, and it closes. Her tattoos and her blood stay.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet cuts her own throat with Carl's knife and the Nothing takes her.
